educationalGoal: The role of engineering in the medical and welfare field is significant. Given that, however, the development of technology to quantify biological signals and changes in biological components and an understanding of the life sciences are essential for such engineering. This course aims to understand how medical engineering has been established, valuing the technologies and biological mechanisms necessary for medical care and diagnosis.
advice: This course will be taught in a lecture format using handouts.               The role of engineering in the medical and welfare field is significant. Given that, however, the development of technology to quantify biological signals and changes in biological components and an understanding of the life sciences are essential for such engineering. This course aims to understand how medical engineering has been established, valuing the technologies and biological mechanisms necessary for medical care and diagnosis.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              This course will be taught in a lecture format using handouts. The course will be based on the contents of the previous courses such as structure and function of the human body, structure and function of cells, neuroscience, and bio instrumentation, so it is necessary to review the contents of these courses. The details of methods and analysis of biomedical measurements in the field of biomedical engineering will be covered in "Biomedical Measurements", so it is recommended to take "Biomedical Engineering" and "Biomedical Measurements" at the same time. To promote understanding, it is better to take "Biomedical Engineering" and "Biomedical Measurements" simultaneously.
